title: Whitetail on camera
rule: Hang a trail camera on a trail, field edge or scrape. Any whitetail it photographs counts.
example: PHOTO whitetail flags=0 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: A clean whitetail
rule: Take a whitetail with a heart or lung shot, then field-dress it.
example: TAKE whitetail flags=1 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Called in
rule: Grunt, bleat or rattle a deer in, then take it within 5 minutes. Calls work best in the rut.
example: TAKE whitetail flags=100 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: A mature buck
rule: Take a buck with 8 points or more.
example: TAKE whitetail flags=100000000000000000000 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Rut hunter
rule: During the rut, take a buck with 8 points or more from a tree stand or blind, with a heart or lung shot.
example: TAKE whitetail flags=100000001000000100001 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Glass the high parks
rule: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on an elk 100 m or more away.
example: GLASS elk flags=0 RIFLE 120m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: A clean elk
rule: Take an elk with a heart or lung shot, then field-dress it.
example: TAKE elk flags=1 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Called in
rule: Call an elk in with the Doe Bleat Call (a cow call) or the Grunt Tube, then take it within 5 minutes.
example: TAKE elk flags=100 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: A herd bull
rule: Take a bull with 5 points a side or better that weighs 270 kg or more.
example: TAKE elk flags=100000000000000000000 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Bugle season
rule: During the rut, take a bull with 5 points a side or better that came to your call, with a heart or lung shot.
example: TAKE elk flags=100000001000000000101 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Close encounter
rule: See a moose clearly from 40 m or closer.

title: A clean moose

title: Called in
rule: Call a moose in with the Doe Bleat Call (a cow call) or the Grunt Tube, then take it within 5 minutes.
example: TAKE moose flags=100 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: A big bull
rule: Take a bull with 7 points a side or more.
example: TAKE moose flags=100000000000000000000 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000

title: Rut bull by the water
rule: During the rut, call in a bull near water and take him with a heart or lung shot.
example: TAKE moose flags=100000101000000000101 RIFLE 30m 100000kg pts=20 herd=5 month=9 tod=3000
